reviewer: Seed-0 witness review (ora qualify robolab contract-witness)
scope: robolab RubiksCubeLeftOfBowlTask at the pinned revision; generated per predicate family (relative_position); seed-0 witness pending. Semantic projection of the official termination, not physical qualification.
task_language: Put the rubiks cube to the left of the bowl

predicate_and_helpers.basis: Read RubiksCubeLeftOfBowlTask terminations: success = object_left_of(object='rubiks_cube', reference_object='bowl', frame_of_reference='robot', mirrored=False, require_gripper_detached=True), and the helpers in conditionals.py and predicate_logic.py; RobolabEnv records success as the TerminationManager's terminated flag, the OR of every non-timeout term.

reset_and_randomization.basis: Scene rubiks_cube_banana_bowl.usda: rubiks_cube, bowl among 4 contact objects. The env's only event is reset_scene_to_default and the task adds none, so every seed resets to the same authored layout; a seed varies physics only.

assets_and_frames.basis: Vector between root positions in the robot root frame, projected on the table plane, inside the direction cone; ORA's public poses use the same robot root frame.

success_timing.basis: DoneTerm success is evaluated every control step; RobolabEnv freezes the env at the first true step (a termination within its first two steps is reset as a physics artifact) and the ORA session latches it.

public_observability.basis: At reset every named object (2) projects into the over-shoulder or wrist camera with a depth reading that does not hide it (witness sha256 22b31587d94f).

success_witness.basis: Witness (seed 0, sha256 22b31587d94f): placed -> True; each case from a fresh reset, objects placed by direct state edits with the robot held.

counterexamples.basis: Witness (seed 0, sha256 22b31587d94f): reset_state -> False; opposite -> False.

no_expert_strategy.basis: Clauses state end conditions only; no approach, grasp, route or motion advice.

privacy.basis: No coordinates, thresholds, fixture or object identifiers, joint values or predicate names enter the public text; numeric limits stay in this private record.

conditions.source_basis: success = object_left_of(object='rubiks_cube', reference_object='bowl', frame_of_reference='robot', mirrored=False, require_gripper_detached=True): the xy vector from the reference's root to the object's root, in the robot root frame, inside the 45-degree cone of the direction.
conditions.interpretation: To the left of the bowl as seen from the robot.

conditions.source_basis: require_gripper_detached=True: gripper_detached checks that no gripper body touches the object above 0.1 N; with release required the level check is skipped.
conditions.interpretation: Release: the gripper touches none of the named objects.
Direction cone and contact force bar withheld.

public_clauses: The Rubik's cube must end up to the left of the bowl as seen from the robot, rather than diagonally beside it.
Let go of the Rubik's cube: the task is not complete while any part of the gripper still touches it.

counterexamples.case: Objects in place while one is still gripped: false by gripper_detached (source-derived, not executed).

witness_plan.note: each case starts from a fresh reset of seed 0; the robot holds its reset pose with the gripper open unless a case grasps; success is any official result over the case's ticks

limitations: Generated from the pinned source; the witness (phase B) covers seed 0 only and uses direct state edits or scripted moves, never a policy rollout. Source-derived negative cases marked as such are not executed.
